The program12–17 December 2026 · French Alps
01Day 1

A private chalet

We pick you up at Geneva Airport and drive into the mountains. For five nights the chalet is ours: sauna, hot tub, a fireplace and private chefs cooking breakfast, lunch and dinner every day.

We will share the exact address before the event.

02Days 2–4

The slopes

Two and a half days of skiing at La Clusaz, up to 2,600 metres. Strong skiers and beginners are both welcome, and there is a timed race on the last ski day.

Ski passes are included. Rental is not.

03Clear sky

A helicopter over Mont Blanc

On the first clear day we fly from the Megève altiport over the Mont Blanc massif, the highest mountain in Western Europe.

The flight moves with the weather.

04Every day

The mastermind

Hot seats where the whole room works on your biggest problem, a live Neural Recoding session on the beliefs that cap how you grow, and a 90-day plan you present to the group before you leave.

Sessions run between the slopes and dinner.

05Evenings

Dinners

Chef dinners at the chalet, one night at a mountain hut, and a gala dinner on the last evening. No stage, just real conversations, good food and a lot of laughs. Every night ends with vin chaud by the fire.

Flights home from 14:00 on 17 December.

Your seat

One seat type, everything included. Seven founders only.

Questions

FAQ

Contact us
Who is this for?

Founders and business owners doing five figures a month and up, who want a week of real work on their business with people at a similar level.

Where is it?

In the Aravis area of Haute-Savoie, between Megève and La Clusaz, about an hour and a quarter from Geneva. The exact address is sent to confirmed guests.

How do I get there?

Fly into Geneva Airport and land by 14:00 on 12 December. We pick everyone up. Book your flight home from 14:00 on 17 December.

I have never skied. Should I come?

Yes. The slopes are optional. The spa, the chalet and the mastermind sessions are there for anyone who wants a quieter day.

What if the weather is bad?

The helicopter flight moves to the first clear day. If a ski day is snowed out, we swap it with a mastermind session or a spa afternoon.

What is included?

The chalet, every breakfast, lunch and dinner, the ski pass, the helicopter flight, the mountain hut and gala dinners, airport transfers and the full mastermind program. Flights and ski rental are not included.

How do I apply?

Message us on Instagram or leave your number above. We have a short call to make sure the room is right for you, then a 50% deposit holds your seat.
